sources_used: LSEG Annual Report FY20-FY24 + H125 results (https://www.lseg.com/en/investor-relations)
_ordering_rationale: LSEG post-Refinitiv : Data & Analytics (~70% CA), ASV (KPI maitre récurrence), Capital Markets, Post Trade, FTSE Russell.

kpis.signal: KPI maitre de la récurrence revenus D&A, croissance soutenue +6-8%/an
kpis.description_fr: Annual Subscription Value : valeur normalisée des abonnements à 12 mois sur D&A (Workspace, datafeeds, analytics). Indicateur leading du CA récurrent.
kpis.description_en: Annual Subscription Value: normalized 12-month value of D&A subscriptions (Workspace, datafeeds, analytics). Leading indicator of recurring revenue.

kpis.signal: ~70% CA groupe, plateforme post-acquisition Refinitiv (2021), partenariat Microsoft (Azure + Teams)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Data & Analytics (Workspace, datafeeds, analytics, customer & third-party risk). Coeur du modèle LSEG post-Refinitiv. Partenariat Microsoft 10 ans.
kpis.description_en: Data & Analytics revenue (Workspace, datafeeds, analytics, customer & third-party risk). Core LSEG model post-Refinitiv. Microsoft 10-year partnership.

kpis.signal: Tradeweb (LSEG détient 53%), volumes obligataires record, FX en croissance
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Capital Markets (Equities, FX, Fixed Income via Tradeweb). Tradeweb (LSEG ~53%) coté NASDAQ, fortes synergies datafeed.
kpis.description_en: Capital Markets revenue (Equities, FX, Fixed Income via Tradeweb). Tradeweb (LSEG ~53%) NASDAQ-listed, strong datafeed synergies.

kpis.signal: LCH clearing IRS/CDS, mouvement vers central clearing post-2008 toujours porteur
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Post Trade (LCH, CC&G clearing house, UnaVista). LCH clearing IRS = leader mondial.
kpis.description_en: Post Trade revenue (LCH, CC&G clearing house, UnaVista). LCH IRS clearing = global leader.

kpis.signal: Indices benchmarks (FTSE 100, Russell 2000), AUM passifs en croissance
kpis.description_fr: CA FTSE Russell (indices benchmarks). Similaire au modèle MSCI/SPGI : revenu lié AUM ETF passifs trackant les indices.
kpis.description_en: FTSE Russell index revenue. MSCI/SPGI-like model: revenue linked to passive ETF AUM tracking indices.

_notes: LSEG FY = calendaire. Sources : Annual Report FY20-FY24 + H125 results. Refinitiv integré 2021.
